name: POI Site Reviewer
description: Plan a sized POI workflow with construction handoffs, plan terrain access, and review final sites against terrain triangles and player capsules. Shared CLI/API, agent-agnostic. Read-only; actual construction and visual review remain required.

options.label: Plan POI workflow and measured brief

bundle.label: Portable review or route-search bundle
bundle.description: plan-poi: request matching poi-request-schema.json. review: portable bundle from cli.mjs pack. plan-route: world and search matching terrain-route-schema.json. See README.md for the agent-agnostic process.
